title: Discipleship
description: A disciple is a student who follows their teacher's whole way of life. Jesus invited ordinary people to leave what they were doing and follow him.

waypoints.title: Following Jesus
waypoints.body: Jesus' first followers were fishermen, tax collectors, and ordinary people who left what they were doing to follow him -- learning not just his words but his whole way of life.

waypoints.title: Everyday Following
waypoints.body: What does 'following Jesus' look like in your everyday life -- at school, with friends, at home?
